findings.title: BOLA in POST /users/<int:uid>/name: missing owner verification

evidence.why: The user ID comes from the URL and is not bound to the authenticated user; any logged‑in user can change any other user's name.

findings.recommendation: Bind the target user ID to the authenticated user by loading the user with a query that includes the current user’s ID or by checking that the loaded user’s ID matches the session user before updating.

findings.title: BOLA in PATCH /users/<int:uid>: missing owner verification

evidence.why: The endpoint accepts any user ID from the URL and updates that user’s record without verifying ownership.

findings.recommendation: Ensure the user ID in the request matches the authenticated user’s ID before applying changes, or load the user with a query that includes the session user ID.

findings.title: BOLA in POST /Customer/Edit: missing owner verification

evidence.why: The method accepts a Customer object with an arbitrary Id and updates it without checking that the Id belongs to the authenticated user.

findings.recommendation: Verify that the customer Id belongs to the current user before calling SaveChanges, or load the customer via a query that includes the user’s Id.

findings.title: BOLA in POST /Customer/EditName: missing owner verification

evidence.why: The customer Id is taken from the request and the record is updated without verifying ownership.

findings.recommendation: Ensure the Id belongs to the authenticated user before saving, or load the customer by user Id and update only that record.

findings.title: BOLA in POST /Customer/Refresh: missing owner verification

evidence.why: The id is supplied by the caller and the customer is updated without checking that it belongs to the authenticated user.

findings.recommendation: Validate that the customer Id belongs to the current user before applying updates, or load the customer via a query that includes the user’s Id.

findings.title: BOLA in ANY /dotnet-legacy/Web/Handlers/GetFile.ashx: missing owner verification

evidence.why: The file identifier comes from the query string and is used to locate and transmit a file without any check that the requesting user owns or is authorized to view that file.

findings.recommendation: Add an ownership check that the file belongs to the authenticated user before transmitting, or restrict the handler to authenticated users only.

findings.title: BOLA in POST <see web.xml servlet-mapping>: missing owner verification

evidence.why: The servlet populates an Account object from arbitrary request parameters and does not verify that the account belongs to the authenticated user.

findings.recommendation: Validate that the account being updated belongs to the current user, or load the account via a query that includes the user’s Id before applying changes.

findings.title: BOLA in GET /php-plain/mongo_find.php: missing owner verification

evidence.why: The endpoint accepts arbitrary query parameters and returns matching documents without restricting them to the authenticated user.

findings.recommendation: Add a filter that limits returned documents to those owned by the current user, or remove the endpoint from public access.
